summary: Use the shared mobile Images grid for new and saved items and support explicit generation and cancellation across customer choices.

procedures.reason: Only the current Catalog actor can cancel jobs in their Store and Images context.
Explicit Catalog form submission reserves one generation per selected choice. The server owns scope, quota, concurrency and cost admission.

evidence.result: Local QA database test passed 20 assertions across atomic choice reservations and replay, scope refusal, cancellation before dispatch, in-flight cost retention without delivery, and preserving a sibling choice result for a later save.
